channel.title: Our Lady of Joy Homilies
channel.description: Weekly homilies from Our Lady of Joy.
channel.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 08, 2026 — 4:00 PM
item.description: Today's Gospel gives us the key to enter into heaven.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 08, 2026 — 11:00 AM
item.description: But those who are called Jews and Greeks alike, Christ the power of God and wisdom of God.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 08, 2026 — 9:00 AM
item.description: So we may describe wisdom also as a perspective More, the highest perspective Looking at the world Looking at what God made in this earth And so we have to trust in God Who has Jesus himself give us the logos The word, the wisdom of God who will teach us how to go into this world,
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 08, 2026 — 7:00 AM
item.description: We too must be ready when the Lord calls us anytime, anywhere, anyplace at your unexpected time.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for October 25, 2026 — 4:00 PM
item.description: To, the expectation was to check all the boxes, follow all the details, big or small.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for October 25, 2026 — 9:00 AM
item.description: There was a little boy who heard in their catechism classes that there are ten commandments from God he said to the teacher only then in our house we have more than that especially for my dad.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for October 25, 2026 — 7:00 AM
item.description: Love God with all your whole being and love your neighbor as yourself.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 01, 2026 — 4:00 PM
item.description: Today in this Mass, let's keep in prayer, special way, for the Notre Dame Saints.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 01, 2026 — 11:00 AM
item.description: There are three states of our church, meaning we are celebrating today the triumphant church, the saints, all the saints.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for November 01, 2026 — 9:00 AM
item.description: The Second Vatican Council with Pope Paul VI, one of the messages there is that for all of us, baptized Catholics, there's what we call universal call to holiness.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for September 13, 2026 — 4:00 PM
item.description: We see that there's continuity between the Old Testament and the New Testament.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for September 13, 2026 — 9:00 AM
item.description: Not unless we know how to forgive, we shall not be forgiven.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for September 13, 2026 — 7:00 AM
item.description: Forgiveness is one of the most difficult, yet most freeing or liberating that we can feel if we forgive and be forgiven.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy

item.title: Homily for September 13, 2026
item.description: What impresses me about these readings is the idea of continuity, especially, specifically, the continuity of God's mercy.
item.itunes:author: Our Lady of Joy
